title: Gift
text:
Gift. Son-in-law wanted something to fit all his movies.
Since I use the smaller size I thought I get this for him.
He likes the case but really would have like to have 3 ring binder capability vs this plastic tabs.
they hold but moving movies around in the case are a big pain the butt - he used a few different words to communicate that to us.
unfortunately we can't find the 3 ring binder version anymore.

product_metadata.title: Case Logic DVB-200 200 CD/DVD and 92 Liner Note Capacity (Black)
features: DVD Wallet holds 200 discs and 92 movie title notes
Innovative Fast-File pockets allow quick storage and immediate access to 16 additional favorite or "now playing" CDs
Quick-Lock Moveable Page System makes re-organizing or alphabetizing your CD collection a snap
Additional slots in ProSleeve pages for "bonus footage" discs
